title: A review record and a lane lint record carry to a new PR whose tree sha matches a reviewed PR's tree
why: Consultant 00:21 CST Nov 14 (relayed; owner priority fb-1556-6, cut repetition): PR #2980 was re-cut as #3376 only to fix a commit trailer, same tree, and review round 1 and lane lint ran again. OWNER ITEM 835 09:05 CST Nov 14 (pick-review-carry-by-tree, asked by the coordinator 09:03; stale-decision protocol on decision pr-review-record): (a) a new PR whose tree is byte-identical to a reviewed PR may cite that record, read by the tool by tree sha (widens what the tool accepts; marked so); (b) keep each PR reviewed on its own head. No star. Measured (lane merge-tool-beats-every-phase, its own n=1, unread by triage and the coordinator): one test-file fix to #3272's phase beat took 08:00 to about 09:03 CST, 3 PRs (#3272, #3403, #3404), 3 lane-lint runs of 22 min each, 4 review agents; #3404's tree is byte-identical to #3403 head 7bc1717bac09 (empty git diff, the lane's claim); that head holds round 1 FAIL (fixed), round 2 PASS, round 3 PASS, net value zero. Meanwhile the coordinator's own undoable pick: #3404 gets one fresh round 1, and the tool says what else is owed. No check change until the owner answers. This step's lane has built nothing past its read (unread). LANE REPORT 09:10 CST Nov 14 (lane session_013NEJKzVWixDqQgAjMzTCgV, 09:04, its own; REST read by the lane; unchecked by triage): option (a) of owner item 835 is BUILT and reviewed in claude-settings #3388 (draft, head 3828002230b4, not merged): in merge/merge.py a replacement PR names its source with a `Replaces #M` or `Carries #M` body line; the source's newest review log and lane-lint PASS then count when the tree sha of the log's Head equals the tree sha of the live head; a carried log keeps its own verdict; an unreadable read reads unknown; `--fix-check` on a replacement with no log starts from the source's log on a tree match; the restart refusal offers carry by tree, then a fix verifier on the delta, then a re-cut last. Review: round 1 FAIL, round 2 FAIL, round 3 PASS, net value zero, fix check PASS (name-only rename); lane lint PASS at the head. It changes the tool's verdict, so it widens what the tool accepts: held draft; runner 10 must not mark it ready until the owner picks (a) or (b); if (b), #3388 is dropped or cut back to the remedy-text change. Also #3391 (debt and notes, docs only), draft, head c746cc1c65a9. Steps read by the lane: replacement-pr-carries-review covered for an identical tree, open for a fix check on a differing tree; record-replacement-pr-rounds open (a replacement keeping the rounds its source owed); not covered: the mailaudit #328 shape (fix check after a PASS round, then round 3, no round 2). Cases: #3376 pinned (cases 7a-7c; a source log is accepted on a tree match and refused on a differing tree) but the carry needs the new PR body to name its source; #3404 carries only if its body has a `Replaces #3403` line; a PR with no named source is NOT carried (case 3; round3 case 4 for lint). Open for the owner: carry with no named source is a further widening; item 835 now says so. Triage told the coordinator; whether runner 10 was told is not recorded. MEASURE UPDATE 09:43 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 09:40, from lane merge-tool-beats-every-phase's log; the coordinator read the record comments itself): one test-file fix to #3272's phase beat, red reported 08:00, handed in ready at 09:37 CST, about 97 min wall: 3 PRs on one tree (#3272, #3403, #3404), lane lints of 22 min (FAIL on the lane's two Red-run trailers) + 11 s (stopped at a main conflict) + 7 min (PASS), 5 lane-touched-tests runs, 8 reviewer agents; the only blocking finding in 3 rounds was round 1's (an unpinned 120 s claim); rounds 2 and 3 on #3403 found nothing blocking. Replaces the earlier 3-lane-lint, 4-agent figure. Item 835 carries the new numbers. Handed to runner 10; #3272 and #3403 close after; the phase-timing build waits for #3404 to merge. SECOND MEASURE 10:44 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 10:41, from runner 10's own count: 11 merges 04:00 to 10:32 CST, about 35 min per merge, n=11, arithmetic only; relayed, unchecked by triage): combined PR #3406 (combine-g1h, draft, head e233aa0a4bef, 72 files, 185 commits, base main 0806bf59d284) folds 23 reviewed lanes. Without the carry it has no record at its head and the 23 lanes go one by one: about 13 h by that arithmetic. With the carry one CI run and one merge is possible, but #3388 as built cites one source PR per `Replaces #M`, so a 23-member combine needs a form the lane did not build. Open: whether #3388 covers many sources, and whether it reads each member's record by head (not read by the coordinator; triage asked this lane at 10:43 CST). #3393 is replaced by #3406; runner 10 closes it. Owner item 835 now has rank 1 (top of its tier) and carries this measure.

The lane first reads what the two related steps already cover and builds only the gap. A guard change: review rounds apply. Not started.
